Build passes now: exit 0, 0 errors.

Fixed 2 real bugs (rest was deprecation noise):
1. `options.js:7` — read `options.retries`, callers now pass `retryCount`
2. `retryPolicy.js:8-10` — threw on `undefined` flag instead of treating it as disabled

Remaining 8 warnings are deprecation noise (Buffer, punycode, etc.) — cosmetic, not blocking. Want those cleaned up too?
